slide6Title: Crane manipulators based on MCV/HCV trucks
slide6Text: Production of vehicles equipped with crane-manipulator units. Use of anti-shift plates, installation of a control distributor block for rear supports, open HOSSEN profile, mounting plates at the base of the crane unit, platform painting in the crane color.
slide7Title: Fuel tankers based on MCV/HCV trucks
slide7Text: Production and supply of fuel tankers with capacities of 8 and 6 cubic meters. Aluminum communications, composite pressure-suction hoses, high-performance fuel dispensing unit.
aboutText1: Our company occupies a leading position in the special equipment market: every day, we contribute to the development of the domestic automotive industry and the strengthening of the Russian economy.
aboutText2: RusTrak is a leading manufacturer of commercial vehicles and specialized equipment. Our work is recognized and highly valued by major Russian corporations and government agencies: we supply specialized equipment to corporations such as Gazprom, Rosatom, Rosseti, RSK MIG, and others.
stats1Text: Over 17 years of operation, Rustrak LLC has grown into a major company specializing in the production and sale of special-purpose equipment
stats2Text: We have supplied 85 regions of the Russian Federation with reliable commercial and specialized equipment
stats3Text: Rustrak LLC values the trust of the automotive industry, confirmed by authorized partnerships with 11 vehicle manufacturers
